objective: Accelerate Shire Journey from W01/P1C01 production into a large coordinated build while minimizing administrative friction and preserving technical, canon, save and performance safety.
source_basis: Project Source PDFs and repository source library
non_negotiable_pipeline: Animated character and creature production assets: FBX only.
Production textures: PNG/TGA; prefer channel packing; no uncompressed BMP.
Heavy production assets: soft references plus asynchronous loading through FStreamableManager; no synchronous heavy LoadObject paths.
Ambient NPC crowd growth uses bounded object pooling; do not use dense Spawn/Destroy churn.
Repeated world detail uses HISM/ISM, LOD and cull bands before density expansion.

execution_model.runtime_serial_lane: P1C01 C3 -> C4 -> D -> character presentation -> living motion/fauna -> quest/audio polish -> target-device profiling
execution_model.scope_boundary: Later-region runtime implementation remains gated by P1C01 Gate 6/7. Preparation is allowed in parallel.

waves.name: Stable foliage material identity
deliverables: Exact normalized foliage material identity binding
waves.validation: Fast asset lane + exact-head technical proof

waves.name: Shire atmosphere production
waves.validation: Exact-head technical proof + rendered review; no expensive real-time recapture path

waves.name: Natural character production bridge
waves.validation: Asset QA then runtime integration in short-lived PRs

waves.name: Spatial audio and foley production
waves.validation: Async asset routing + listening/device acceptance when integrated

waves.name: Whole-game source preparation
waves.validation: No later-region runtime promotion before Gate 6/7

administrative_reduction: Keep one repository-native Project Manager report every 24 hours for owner visibility; it is informational and never a production gate.
Do not reopen historical W00 repair notes without a concrete regression.
Batch documentation/governance changes by production wave.
Do not require Unreal builds for source indexing, provenance or non-runtime warehouse staging.
A failed runtime gate blocks only the affected implementation lane; independent safe preparation continues.
acceptance_boundary: STATIC/COMPILE/machine evidence never implies PIE/device/visual/pacing acceptance.
